 476: 
 477: def import_codex_logs(
 478:     logs_path: Path,
 479:     canonical_path: Path,
 480:     world_id: str,
 481:     secret_paths_path: Path | None = None,
 482: ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 483:     root, paths = markdown_paths(logs_path)
 484:     redaction_rules = load_redaction_rules(secret_paths_path)
 485:     documents = tuple(
 486:         sorted(
 487:             (parse_document(path, root, redaction_rules) for path in paths),
 488:             key=lambda document: (document.occurred_at, document.relative_path),
 489:         )
 490:     )
 491:     canonical_path = canonical_path.resolve()
 492:     canonical_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 493:     with closing(sqlite3.connect(canonical_path)) as connection:
 494:         connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
 495:         _initialize_canonical(connection)
 496:         with connection:
 497:             connection.execute(
 498:                 """
 499:                 INSERT INTO worlds (world_id, name, description, enabled)
 500:                 VALUES (?, ?, 'Imported Markdown Codex conversations', 1)
 501:                 ON CONFLICT(world_id) DO NOTHING
 502:                 """,
 503:                 (world_id, world_id.replace("-", " ").title()),
 504:             )
 505:             for document in documents:
 506:                 _remove_previous_document(connection, world_id, document)
 507:                 conversation = document.entities[0]
 508:                 conversation_id = _entity_node_id(world_id, document, conversation)
 509:                 for entity in document.entities:
 510:                     node_id = _entity_node_id(world_id, document, entity)
 511:                     source_ref = (
 512:                         f"codex://{document.relative_path}#document"
 513:                         if entity.type is EntityType.CONVERSATION
 514:                         else f"codex://{document.relative_path}#L{entity.line_number}"
 515:                     )
 516:                     record = _record_for(document, entity, source_ref)
 517:                     _upsert_node(
 518:                         connection,
 519:                         node_id,
 520:                         world_id,
 521:                         entity,
 522:                         document.occurred_at,
 523:                     )
 524:                     _upsert_import_record(connection, world_id, record, entity)
 525:                     _upsert_evidence(
 526:                         connection,
 527:                         world_id,
 528:                         node_id,
 529:                         record,
 530:                         entity,
 531:                     )
 532:                     if entity.type is not EntityType.CONVERSATION:
 533:                         _upsert_membership_edge(
 534:                             connection,
 535:                             world_id,
 536:                             node_id,
 537:                             conversation_id,
 538:                             document.occurred_at,
 539:                         )
 540:             resolved_supersessions = sum(
 541:                 _upsert_supersession(connection, world_id, document, statement)
 542:                 for document in documents
 543:                 for statement in document.supersessions
 544:             )
 545:     return {
 546:         "importedConversations": len(documents),
 547:         "importedDecisions": sum(
 548:             entity.type is EntityType.DECISION
 549:             for document in documents
 550:             for entity in document.entities
 551:         ),
 552:         "importedPlans": sum(
 553:             entity.type is EntityType.PLAN
 554:             for document in documents
 555:             for entity in document.entities
 556:         ),
 557:         "topicCandidates": len(
 558:             {
 559:                 entity.canonical_name.casefold()
 560:                 for document in documents
 561:                 for entity in document.entities
 562:                 if entity.type is EntityType.TOPIC
 563:             }
 564:         ),
 565:         "redactions": {
 566:             category: sum(
 567:                 document.redactions[category] for document in documents
 568:             )
 569:             for category in (
 570:                 "configured_secret_path",
 571:                 "key_like_value",
 572:                 "token_like_value",
 573:             )
 574:         },
 575:         "explicitSupersessions": resolved_supersessions,
 576:         "world": world_id,
 577:     }
 578: 
 579: 
 580: def main() -> None:
 581:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
 582:     parser.add_argument("--logs", type=Path, required=True)
 583:     parser.add_argument("--canonical", type=Path, required=True)
 584:     parser.add_argument("--world", required=True)
 585:     parser.add_argument("--secret-paths", type=Path)
 586:     arguments = parser.parse_args()
 587:     report = import_codex_logs(
 588:         arguments.logs,
 589:         arguments.canonical,
 590:         arguments.world,

- **Medium — replacement grammar now creates false supersession from ordinary domain prose.** Spec: “A direct statement that one decision or plan replaces another emits high-confidence supersession evidence.” `INLINE_REPLACEMENT_PATTERN` treats any `Decision:` or `Plan:` text containing `replaces` as a claim-to-claim supersession.
